description: A special edition celebrating 50 years of the Royal Oak, this chronograph features a beautifully crafted design with precision timing capabilities, embodying a legacy of excellence.

name: Breguet Tradition Seconde Rétrograde 7097
description: Superimposed on the emblematic off-centred dial, the small seconds are indicated at 10 o’clock thanks to a retrograde hand.

name: Jaeger LeCoultre Master Ultra Thin Tourbillon
description: 40 mm - Pink Gold 750/1000 (18 carats) - Automatic winding. In an aperture at 6 o'clock, the Master Ultra Thin Tourbillon watch gives way to the spellbinding ballet of its tourbillon, enhanced by a row of diamonds that adorns and encircle its bezel. Designed to enhance the spectacle of the tourbillon and its new gold bridge, the setting of its 68 diamonds exemplify the talent of the master craftsmen who meticulously select each gemstone before working to bring out its shine and brilliance. Visible under its sapphire crystal, the case-back of the watch offers another, equally fascinating, spectacle: That of its mechanical self-winding movement, the Jaeger-LeCoultre Caliber 978G.

description: The Vacheron Constantin Overseas Self-winding 34.5mm combines sophistication with sports elegance, featuring a robust case and an intricately designed dial that appeals to watch enthusiasts.

name: Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar 43mm
description: The Ulysse Nardin Marine Chronometer Annual Calendar combines nautical inspiration with precise mechanics. It features an annual calendar complication, requiring adjustment only once a year, and is powered by the in-house UN-113 movement. With a classic marine chronometer design, it includes a power reserve indicator, small seconds at 6 o'clock, and a large date display. Its 43mm case is available in stainless steel or rose gold, maintaining the brand's heritage of creating robust, maritime-inspired timepieces.

description: The dial, in the style of a classic Portugieser, features a constant-force tourbillon together with displays for the 96-hour power reserve and sidereal time, which, among other things, is needed to find the same star each night in the same position.

name: Vacheron Constantin Overseas Tourbillon Skeleton 42.5 mm
description: The Vacheron Constantin Overseas Tourbillon Skeleton 42.5 mm is a masterpiece of horological artistry, showcasing an intricate skeletonized design that highlights the intricate workings of its movement. With a tourbillon that enhances precision and a sporty yet elegant aesthetic, this timepiece is perfect for discerning collectors and watch enthusiasts alike. Its durable stainless steel case and water resistance make it suitable for both casual and formal occasions, embodying the spirit of adventure and sophistication.
